_provenance: Pre-Renewal Novice skills as documented by iRO Wiki classic and the rAthena pre-re skill database (facts only). resname = client icon in data\texture\유저인터페이스\item\<resname>.bmp. Quest skills are learned through NPC quests in the classic game; until those quests exist they are granted to new characters (documented simplification). Mage skills: SP, hits, cast time and after-cast delay per iRO Wiki classic (Medium-high confidence; Soul Strike / Napalm Beat delays Medium).

NV_BASIC.name: Basic Skill
NV_BASIC.desc: Unlocks basic interface features as it levels. Level 3 lets you sit (Insert), level 9 is required for a job change.

NV_FIRSTAID.name: First Aid
NV_FIRSTAID.desc: Bandage your wounds to restore 5 HP. Costs 3 SP.

NV_TRICKDEAD.name: Play Dead
NV_TRICKDEAD.desc: Feign death. Monsters lose interest and cannot target you, but you cannot move or attack. Use again to get up. Costs 5 SP.

SM_SWORD.name: Sword Mastery
SM_SWORD.desc: Increases ATK by 4 per level with daggers and one-handed swords. Mastery ATK ignores DEF.

SM_RECOVERY.name: Increase HP Recovery
SM_RECOVERY.desc: Every 10 seconds while standing still, recover 5 HP + 0.2% of Max HP per level. Healing items restore 10% more per level.

SM_BASH.name: Bash
SM_BASH.desc: A powerful strike: ATK +30% per level and HIT +5% per level against one enemy in melee range.

SM_MAGNUM.name: Magnum Break
SM_MAGNUM.desc: An explosion around you hitting every enemy within 2 cells: ATK +20% per level, HIT +10% per level. Fire element. Requires Bash level 5.

MG_SRECOVERY.name: Increase SP Recovery
MG_SRECOVERY.desc: Every 10 seconds while standing still, recover 3 SP + 0.2% of Max SP per level. Healing items restore 2% more SP per level (item part not yet applied).

MG_NAPALMBEAT.name: Napalm Beat
MG_NAPALMBEAT.desc: Ghost-element psychic blast on a target and the enemies around it (3x3). MATK 80% + 10% per level, divided among everyone hit. Cast time 1 s.

MG_SOULSTRIKE.name: Soul Strike
MG_SOULSTRIKE.desc: Ghost-element spirit bolts: 1 bolt per two levels (1-5) of 100% MATK each. +5% damage per level against Undead. Cast time 0.5 s. Requires Napalm Beat level 4.

MG_COLDBOLT.name: Cold Bolt
MG_COLDBOLT.desc: Drops one water-element bolt of 100% MATK per level on the target. Cast time 0.7 s per level, reduced by DEX.

MG_FIREBOLT.name: Fire Bolt
MG_FIREBOLT.desc: Drops one fire-element bolt of 100% MATK per level on the target. Cast time 0.7 s per level, reduced by DEX.

MG_LIGHTNINGBOLT.name: Lightning Bolt
MG_LIGHTNINGBOLT.desc: Strikes the target with one wind-element bolt of 100% MATK per level. Cast time 0.7 s per level, reduced by DEX.
